candidates.title: NumaOracle TWAP average-tick uses integer division -> negative-tick rounding skew
candidates.description: getV3SqrtPriceAvg computes avg tick = (tickCumulatives[1]-tickCumulatives[0]) / int56(int32(interval)); integer division truncates toward zero, so for a NEGATIVE cumulative-tick delta the avg tick rounds UP (less negative) -> price skew (the revert-lend H-05 / oracle.md negative-tick class). LIKELY MITIGATED here by the min/max-of-{short,long,spot} selection + spot-offset bound; record as SAME_AREA-to-an-already-covered-class pending reveal.
